what: crates/base-db/src/table.rs `Column::set` (lines 68-70): the loop `while self.words.len() <= raw { self.words.append(AtomicU64::new(0)); }` takes and drops AppendVec's writer flag (an atomic swap, about 20 cycles) and publishes once per ID; for a jump of many IDs that is 20+ cycles each against a bound of one zeroing store. blaze-mem now has `AppendVec::writer()` and `Writer::extend_with(count, make)` (crates/blaze-mem/src/append.rs), one flag swap and one publish for all of them. Exact edit: replace the `while` loop with `let len = self.words.len(); if len <= raw { self.words.writer().extend_with((raw - len + 1) as usize, |_| AtomicU64::new(0)); }`. Same values, same final length, same single-writer rule (the files' writer lock still serializes it).
